name: videogame-platform-contract-tooling
description: Repository-local tooling for validating the approved OpenAPI contract.

scripts.build:openapi-docs: redocly build-docs docs/architecture/api/openapi.yaml --output docs/architecture/api/reference/index.html --title "VideoGame Platform API Reference" --disableGoogleFont --lint-config error && node tools/openapi-validation/normalize-generated-html.mjs
scripts.validate:openapi: npm run validate:openapi:syntax && npm run validate:openapi:lint && npm run validate:openapi:schemas && npm run validate:openapi:examples
